features.name: Star Map
features.desc: You carry a star map; you know Guidance and always have Guiding Bolt prepared, which you can cast without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.desc: At the start of your turn, you roll a d6: an even (Weal) or odd (Woe) omen. As a Reaction, you add or subtract the d6 to an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check of a creature near you. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.desc: Your constellations grow stronger; in Dragon form, you gain a Fly Speed.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.desc: In your Starry Form, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
